title: Immortalized endometrial stromal cells transduced with lentiviral GFP and precipitated with VDR 1
characteristics_ch1: cell line: T-HESC | cell type: Endometrial Stromal Cells | genotype: Lentiviral-GFP plasmid | treatment: 0.01% v/v ethyl alcohol
treatment_protocol_ch1: The cells were transfected with each siRNA in OPTI-MEM containing 2% v/v charcoal-stripped fetal bovine serum. 1,25(OH)2D3 treatment was conducted by dilution in OPTI-MEM containing 2% v/v charcoal-stripped fetal bovine serum.
growth_protocol_ch1: The lentiviral plasmid-transduced cells were maintained in DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 10% Fetal Bovine Serum and 10 μg/mL puromycin. The regular endometrial stromal cells were maintained in DMEM/F-12 supplemented with 10% Fetal Bovine Serum, 100 units/mL penicillin, and 100 μg/mL streptomycin. All the cells were cultured and grown in a 5% CO2 and 37°C incubator. Cell media was changed every three days, and cells were passaged before reaching 90% confluency.
extract_protocol_ch1: Targeted DNA amplicons were isolated using the Epicypher CUTANA Cut&Run Kit Version 3. | A total of 550,000 cells per sample were collected in DNA LoBind 1.5mL tubes containing wash buffer. Cells were captured with BioMag Plus Concanavalin A beads and incubated with corresponding antibodies overnight at 4°C in antibody incubation buffer. After washing away antibodies, pAG-MNase generated by the NIEHS proteomics core was added and incubated for 30 minutes at room temperature. After washing, CaCl2 was added and incubated for 30 minutes in an aluminum cold block placed in ice. The protein-DNA complexes were released by incubating at 37°C for 10 minutes. DNA was purified using the Qiagen MiniElute PCR Purification Kit. Sequencing libraries were prepared using the NEBNext Ultra II DNA library preparation kit for Illumina according to the manufacturer’s instructions, with 12-14 cycles of PCR amplification. The PCR products were quantified using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit, and quality control was performed with Tapestation Analysis. The libraries were sequenced by the NIEHS sequencing core.

extract_protocol_ch1: Targeted DNA amplicons were isolated using the Epicypher CUTANA Cut&Run Kit Version 3. | A total of 550,000 cells per sample were collected in DNA LoBind 1.5mL tubes containing wash buffer. Cells were captured with BioMag Plus Concanavalin A beads and incubated with corresponding antibodies overnight at 4°C in antibody incubation buffer. After washing away antibodies, pAG-MNase generated by the NIEHS proteomics core was added and incubated for 30 minutes at room temperature. After washing, CaCl2 was added and incubated for 30 minutes in an aluminum cold block placed in ice. The protein-DNA complexes were released by incubating at 37°C for 10 minutes. DNA was purified using the Qiagen MiniElute PCR Purification Kit. Sequencing libraries were prepared using the NEBNext Ultra II DNA library preparation kit for Illumina according to the manufacturer’s instructions, with 12-14 cycles of PCR amplification. The PCR products were quantified using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit, and quality control was performed with Tapestation Analysis. The libraries were sequenced by the NIEHS sequencing core.
